title: Email/set create: text_body not sanitized for bare NUL bytes
description: email/set.rs create_one_email applies strip_crlf to subject and from_email but not to text_body. A body with a bare NUL byte would produce a malformed RFC 5322 article. The security policy says treat all input as attacker-controlled; text_body should at minimum be validated to exclude NUL bytes before being written to IPFS.
